title: Where does partner value compound?
prompt: Pick the statement that describes durable partner differentiation.

options.text: Custom agents, connectors, and embedded experiences that create reusable IP and higher-margin offerings.
options.feedback: Correct. Partners differentiate with custom agents, connectors, and embedded experiences that create reusable IP and higher-margin offerings.

options.text: Reselling licences at the largest possible discount.
options.feedback: Not this one. Discount depth is not differentiation, and it does not create reusable IP.

options.text: Rebuilding enterprise search from scratch for each customer.
options.feedback: Not this one. Search is platform capability; partner value sits in extension and workflow work.

takeaway: Technology partners build on Glean's open, extensible platform using APIs, MCP-based tools, embedded experiences, agent extensions, and the connector framework.
